fix(plugin): fix Kimi-K3's KDA autotune key in the plugin, not the vLLM image (#2835)

#2818 fixed Kimi-K3's import failure under Triton 3.8

    ValueError: key contains names that are not kernel arguments: NC.

by applying vllm-project/vllm#60446 as a patch on the vLLM build. That
only reaches a deployment once its vLLM image is rebuilt: the nightly
vllm-latest built before #2818 merged still fails every PR's Kimi-K3 cell.

Fix it where the plugin fixes vLLM. register_model wraps
triton.autotune: for a kernel defined under vllm.models.kimi_k3 it drops
the key names that are not kernel arguments, which is what #60446 does
by hand, and passes every other kernel through unchanged. The decorator
runs at import, so the wrapper has to precede any import of
vllm.models.kimi_k3; vLLM's model-inspection subprocess, where the
failure surfaced, runs load_general_plugins and so this hook first. A
vLLM that carries #60446 names no such key and nothing is dropped; an
INFO line names each dropped key.

The image patch and its dockerfile steps are removed; the vLLM recipe
is back to its state before #2818.

Co-authored-by: perzhang <perzhang@amd.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
